en.title: How to Efficiently Operate a Software Factory at Uber Scale
en.hook: Uber's platform engineering strategies for optimizing build, test, and deployment pipelines to maintain velocity across thousands of developers.
key_takeaways: CI/CD optimization through large-scale build and test automation to minimize infrastructure costs
Building a standardized Internal Developer Platform (IDP) to enhance Developer Experience (DevEx)
Automated governance and quality monitoring across thousands of microservices

zh.title: 如何高效运营 Uber 规模的软件工厂
zh.hook: Uber 平台工程实践：解析如何在超大规模微服务与代码库下优化构建、测试与部署流水线，保持数千名工程师的高效产出。
key_takeaways: 通过大规模构建与测试自动化优化 CI/CD 流水线，有效降低基础设施成本
构建标准化的内部开发者平台 (IDP)，全面提升开发者体验 (DevEx)
实施自动化治理与质量监控，确保数千个微服务符合合规与安全标准
